en.headline: AI diagnosis and /oc fixes; 9 commits, 5 issue events on sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu
en.summary: On 2026-10-19 `sogeisetsu` made 9 own commits to `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, plus 6 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. Work centered on the AI diagnosis pipeline: a new feature adds automatic diagnosis when all AI legs fail and a manual `/oc` recheck entry, while `opencode.yml` was fixed because its `if` cannot use `toLower`. Two temporary test commits broke things: the `/oc` login gate was pointed at a nonexistent account to check that non-owner comments are skipped, and the three legs' model ids were set to invalid values to force a real failure; a revert restored both. Two fixes stopped the summary window assertion from hard-comparing against the current day (the cause of `check.yml` failing at midnight) and made event pagination treat HTTP 422 as non-fatal via the Link header. Codemap baselines were refreshed twice, to `46667bc` and `4719825`. Issue activity was confined to `#9` ([test] opencode /oc smoke（临时，验完即关）), opened, commented on three times, and closed — **5 issue events** with 5 comments on the thread. Two replies came from `github-actions[bot]`, including a `pong` from a workflow run; no pull requests, reviews, releases, or discussions were recorded.

zh.headline: AI 诊断与 /oc 修复：sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu 9 次提交、5 个 issue 事件
zh.summary: 2026-10-19，`sogeisetsu` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 完成 9 次本人提交，另有 6 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。当天工作集中在 AI 诊断链路：新增「三条腿全部失败时自动诊断」以及 `/oc` 手动补查入口，并修复 `opencode.yml` 中 `if` 不能使用 `toLower` 的问题。两次临时测试提交故意制造异常：把 `/oc` 的 login 门指向不存在的账号，以验证「非本人评论 → skipped」；再把三条腿的 model id 改成不存在的值，以造出一次真实失败；随后一次 revert 把这两处恢复。两处修复让 summary 窗口断言不再与「此刻的今天」硬比（`check.yml` 半夜必红的根因），并让事件分页不再把 HTTP 422 当致命错误、改以 Link 头为准。codemap 映射基线刷新了两次，分别到 `46667bc` 和 `4719825`。issue 活动只涉及 `#9`（[test] opencode /oc smoke（临时，验完即关）），该 issue 被新开、收到三次评论后关闭，共 **5 个 issue 事件**，线程内共 5 条评论。`github-actions[bot]` 在该 issue 下回复了两次，其中一条是工作流运行返回的 `pong`；当天没有 pull request、review、release 或 discussion 记录。
